provenance_notes.realtime: Snapshots are captures of official source data at the listed snapshot time.
provenance_notes.model_archive: Only run-specific archived GoMOFS forecasts are eligible for historical forecast comparisons.
provenance_notes.reconstructed_dashboard_snapshot: Dashboard-capture reconstructions are marked explicitly and are not treated as an official NOAA forecast archive.
provenance_notes.observations: Historical observations describe what happened, not what a model forecast beforehand.
provenance_notes.community: Reddit and other community reports are anecdotal unless independently verified.
provenance_notes.facebook: Public Facebook coverage is not assumed comprehensive; inaccessible or unindexed posts are not fabricated.
